instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Keep the text, numbers and media addresses of public posts I name by link, through a public mirror, without opening the posts' site", and give it links (Links to public posts).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:keep-public-posts-by-link and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: For each link to a public post (x.com or twitter.com status links; the link pattern is in harvest-settings.json) asks a third-party public mirror for the post as JSON and keeps its text, counts, author and the addresses of its media, never the media themselves.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: record:sources (records:read, records:write).
